lake-pullback.method: Manual cabin roof span in decoded first/middle/last frames. At this size SIFT has too few surviving matches.

cases.name: ferry-dolly
cases.review: Strong forward move; mild window-edge drift.
cases.prompt: A quiet ferry cabin at blue hour, warm yellow lights in the windows, calm water. The boat stays still. Camera movement: Dolly in. Glide slowly toward the subject. Follow the guide's camera path and preserve the scene, objects, colors and lighting in the first frame. One continuous shot. Natural quiet ambience.

cases.name: bowl-dolly-zoom

measurementLimits: Apparent image scale, not physical camera calibration or proof of identity. Feature matches and forward/backward optical flow use RANSAC; manual review determines acceptance.
